# Atlascub

Translating classic Indian handloom textures and premium combed cottons into timeless, modern silhouettes. Designed for generation-spanning daily wear and optimized as a high-performance progressive web application (PWA).

## Core Store Navigation
- [Homepage](https://www.atlascub.in/) - Main branding showcase, cinematic lookbooks, and featured curated items.
- [Shop Catalog](https://www.atlascub.in/shop) - Full retail directory sorted by modern silhouettes and lifestyle fits.
- [Collections](https://www.atlascub.in/collections/all) - Special seasonal editions, limited capsule drops, and custom drapes.

## Support & Identity Information
- [About Us](https://www.atlascub.in/about) - The Atlascub Studio private limited design philosophy, sourcing metrics, and story.
- [Help Center & Support](https://www.atlascub.in/support) - Customer care terminal for orders, sizing charts, and standard assistance.
- [Contact Channels](https://www.atlascub.in/contact) - Digital PR inquiries, customer care routes, and direct support.

## Legal & Compliance Operations
- [Privacy Policy](https://www.atlascub.in/privacy) - System data compliance schemas and encryption outlines.
- [Terms of Service](https://www.atlascub.in/terms) - Standard terms of transaction, application usage, and site guidelines.
- [Returns & Exchanges](https://www.atlascub.in/returns) - Protocol matrices for item validation, processing windows, and collection steps.
- [Shipping Policy](https://www.atlascub.in/shipping-policy) - Delivery processing limits, domestic logistics coverage, and tax values.
